problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 3 \\ -1 & -2 & 1 & -3 \\ 8 & 16 & -8 & 24\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

activity_context.topic_title: Solving 3x3 Singular Systems of Equations Using Gaussian Elimination

feedback.problem:
Consider the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}-{x}_{1}+2{x}_{3}=2 \\ -3{x}_{1}+6{x}_{3}=6 \\ 4{x}_{1}-8{x}_{3}=-8.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for the system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 2 \\ -3 & 0 & 6 & 6 \\ 4 & 0 & -8 & -8\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 2 \\ -3 & 0 & 6 & 6 \\ 4 & 0 & -8 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ -3 & 0 & 6 & 6 \\ 4 & 0 & -8 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 4 & 0 & -8 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
